events.title: The Fixer is at the Steam Next Fest
events.summary: The Steam Next Fest runs from October 19 to 26, and The Fixer is in it. The demo is free on our Steam page, and you can play it right now. Two lives at once You are a rising footballer chasing titles on Saturday, and a fixer selling pieces of the match the rest of the week. In week one, the syndicate offers you your first match to fix. events.title: Patch 0.6.4: first-week fixes and a safer end of demo
events.summary: The demo is out and the Next Fest is almost here, so 0.6.4 is a round of fixes for the first weeks of a career and the end of the demo. It applies to both the demo and the full game. The demo covers the first ten weeks. The end-of-demo screen At the end of the demo, the restart button used to delete your save with no warning. Now it asks you to confirm first. events.title: Patch 0.6.3: the game starts in your language
events.summary: Solo dev here. If you downloaded the demo and it opened in French, I'm sorry, that one is on me. 0.6.3 fixes how the game chooses its language. The right language from the start Until this update, the game and the demo both opened in French on the first launch, whatever language you played in. Changing it meant a trip to Settings. events.title: Patch 0.6.1: no more leftover French in English, Spanish and Italian
events.summary: Solo dev here. A small follow-up to 0.6.0: a translation pass and three display fixes. The text reads in your language now If you played in English, Spanish or Italian, some text still came up in French. 0.6.1 translates it. That is 1,060 bits of text that used to show in French, now in the language you play in. events.title: Patch 0.6.0: the match is simulated for real
events.summary: Solo dev here. Version 0.6.0 is a big one. The headline: the match is now simulated instead of scripted. The match is played, not written Before, the scoreline was decided up front and then animated on a schematic pitch. Now the match runs as it happens. Twenty-two players, each with a position and a speed, chase a loose ball that can be intercepted. A goal only counts when the ball crosses the line. events.title: Dev update #1: I painted the whole week
events.summary: Solo dev here. Today I pushed a visual pass. It changes how most of the game looks: the week you plan, and the match you fix. The career hub, in one place Your week now sits on one screen: the week timeline up top, your phone in the middle, the career file and your finances on the right, all over an animated backdrop. There are 12 backdrops to unlock (rain, falling cash, floodlights, marble), and the demo hands you every one. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46222994/7dc535ab0d3cfba4b6ec28a0386cb57f2cc17488.p
